info.description: A curated read-only subset of the Google Drive API v3, shipped with the mcpx google-drive example declaration (#1936). Google publishes Drive as a discovery document rather than an OpenAPI document; this document covers only the read operations the declaration exposes: listing and reading file metadata, reading the account's storage usage, and listing shared drives.
info.title: Google Drive (mcpx example subset)

get.description: Returns the caller's Drive information: the user, storage quota and usage, and the export formats the service supports.
Lists the shared drives the caller can access.

parameters.description: Maximum number of drives to return.
parameters.name: pageSize

get.description: Lists files in the caller's Drive. The q parameter is Drive's query language (e.g. name contains 'report' and trashed = false); omit it to list recent files.

parameters.description: A Drive query string filtering the files returned.
parameters.name: q

parameters.description: Maximum number of files to return.
parameters.name: pageSize

parameters.description: Comma-separated fields to include for each file.
parameters.name: fields

get.description: Returns the metadata for one file: name, MIME type, size, timestamps, owners and parents. This reads metadata only, not the file's contents.
